'''Spined pucs''' were an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Frog/Legends|frog-like]] creature. Spined pucs and giant spined pucs were native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:SP" /> Another race known as [[pug jumper]]s were native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> Spined pucs were named for the spiny ridges along its back and sides that carried a powerful toxin capable of blinding its victim.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> Spined pucs had [[Leather/Legends|leathery]] hides.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spined pucs were creatures in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The concept art annotation shown in ''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]'' initially identified the spined puc simply as "frog."<ref name="Pencil">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref>
